source_path: GetEdge original by Federico De Ponte (fastmotion engine, 2026-10-26; no upstream package)
note: Original GetEdge work: a Remotion motion engine (camera with velocity motion blur, spring pop-ins, typing chat, 3D carousel, card fan, stat bars, whip transitions) plus a 27 s demo built only from engine blocks with a fictional brand. Prepared for release on 2026-10-29: the private 105 s study film, its reference-comparison QA scripts and its bundled handwriting font were removed, every third-party brand name and the study film's mascot were replaced with neutral defaults, and the unused @remotion/google-fonts dependency was dropped. Remotion (installed from npm, not vendored) is under the Remotion License. No footage, logos, fonts or private data ship in this bundle.
